svg.text: A100 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · training · row-kernel path: d_pair 256 / 384 / 512, 8 / 12 / 16 heads x 32, bf16, broadcast dropout, L = 128k
forward (saves xh_aug, mean / rstd, y, bias, o, lse)
R1 · pack, LayerNorm rows, projections, bias planes
y = xh_aug @ W'_aug.T # q | k | v | g | bias heads
bias = planes of y's bias columns, masked
o[h] = softmax(q[h] @ k[h].T / sqrt(hd) + bias[h], -1) @ v[h]; lse (base 2)
q, k, v, g (columns of y)
yo = a @ W_o.T; out = x + yo · ds
HBM (sizes at L = 768, d_pair 256, 8 heads x 32)
backward; D = [dq | dk | dv | dg], one buffer, each slice written by its producer
dy = dout · ds # in the starting frame
do = da · sigmoid(g); dg = da · o · s · (1 - s)
a = sigmoid(g) · o; Δ = Σ_d o · do # per head
B3 · attention backward (bias transpose, key side, query side + db reduce)
dS = P (do v^T - Δ); dq = sm_scale · dS @ k; dk = sm_scale · dS^T q; dv = P^T do
db[h, j, k] = Σ_i dS_i # bf16 partials of 4 rows, a fixed-order reduce
dxn = D @ W_cat # cuBLAS, K = 4 H hd
dx = rstd (dxn γ - mean(dxn γ) - xh mean(dxn γ xh)) + db-term + dout
G = Dᵀ @ xh_aug; G_b = dbᵀ @ xh_aug # K = L²
dW = G γ + G[:, D] βᵀ; dγ, dβ; dW_o = dyᵀ @ a
HBM (sizes at L = 768, d_pair 256, 8 heads x 32)
